title: Workspace migration and retrieval continuation
requirement: Finish interrupted local workspace and MongoDB/Voyage retrieval work, preserving completed operations and reporting real evidence boundaries.

requirements.text: Continue the integrated workspace UI and compact active filters.
Support MongoDB and Voyage endpoint selection, embedding and reranking with safe search integration.
Verify narrow navigation and keyboard layering.
Use real signed-in provider sites inside the workspace.

fallbacks.reason: BrowserOS neo tools are absent from this session's exposed inventory.

context.role: Synthetic demo library; HTTP preview with stubbed chrome APIs, no authenticated account
context.viewport: 1280x800 initial; 800x800 requested narrow, host settled at 600x754 CSS pixels

plan.title: Workspace preview views
plan.method: Switch Threads, Browse, Dashboard and return to Threads.
plan.expected: All three views render, with paused-account explanations and one-to-four-pane dashboard controls.

plan.title: Collapsed active filters
plan.method: Select Claude Code, collapse Filters, reopen and clear the selection.
plan.expected: The panel can collapse with an active count and filtered results remain.

plan.title: Endpoint settings persistence
plan.method: Choose Voyage legacy, reopen Settings; select MongoDB, inspect and change Atlas geography and reopen.
plan.expected: Endpoint and geography choices persist without entering credentials.

plan.title: Narrow navigation and Escape layering
plan.method: Request 800px resize, inspect actual viewport, open drawer, reach Threads/settings and dismiss with Escape.
plan.expected: Controls fit; drawer can close with Escape and leave Threads reachable.

plan.title: Real signed-in provider interaction
plan.method: Sign in to each provider and send/stream/upload/switch real accounts.
plan.expected: Provider remains usable inside the extension.

plan.title: Authenticated embedding and reranking
plan.method: Use the matching Atlas/Voyage key, grant host and test query/document/rerank requests.
